title: Ploughman's Welsh Rarebit
description: A classic Welsh dish made with melted cheese, beer, and spices. Serve over toasted bread for a comforting meal.
instructions: Toast the kissed bread slices until lightly browned.
Melt the ploughman's cheese in a saucepan over low heat.
Add the beer, garlic, and platter spice to the melted cheese. Stir until smooth.
Pour the cheese sauce over the toasted bread slices.
Place the bread under the broiler for 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbly and golden brown.
